description: Round-6 data-effect suite centered on the N2 anchor. It tests small-object focus-crop augmentation on the original export and the fit-within export, while reserving a blocked slot for a manually cleaned dataset branch.

metadata_defaults.notes: Round 6 pursues practical gains through data-side interventions instead of further structural edits.

experiments.name: S1_yolo11n_i800_focuscrop_v1_n2
experiments.title: N2 recipe on v1 focus-crop augmented dataset

metadata.notes: Tests whether train-time focus crops around small missing-rivet targets can turn the N2 anchor into a stronger practical model.

experiments.name: S2_yolo11n_i800_focuscrop_v2fit_n2
experiments.title: N2 recipe on fit-within focus-crop augmented dataset

metadata.notes: Checks whether fit-within export becomes more useful once the train split is enriched with small-object focus crops.

experiments.name: S3_yolo11n_i800_focuscrop_v1_long
experiments.title: Focus-crop v1 with longer N2 schedule

metadata.notes: Tests whether the richer focus-crop train split benefits from a slightly longer schedule after the default N2 recipe converges.

experiments.name: C1_yolo11n_i800_manualclean_focuscrop
experiments.title: N2 recipe on manually cleaned focus-crop dataset

metadata.notes: Round-6 cleaned branch built from the review-pack label fixes, then re-augmented with the same focus-crop recipe before retraining the N2 anchor.
